sentences.en: You mentioned Franco A.
sentences.zh: 你提到了弗兰科·A。

sentences.en: Yes, Franco A.
sentences.zh: 是的，弗兰科·A。

sentences.zh: 我从联邦刑事警察局得到了通知。

sentences.en: They had found a diary of Franco A.,
sentences.zh: 他们发现了弗兰科·A的一本日志，

sentences.zh: 弗兰科·A，前联邦国防军军官，

sentences.zh: 上面有一份名单，

sentences.en: including the foreign minister,
sentences.zh: 包括外交部长、

sentences.zh: 一些知识分子、一些人权活动人士，还有我的名字，克劳迪娅·罗特，这就是所谓的动物名单，

sentences.en: to be killed, enemies to be killed really he's a soldier in the Bundeswehr and he posed as a Syrian
sentences.zh: 要被杀害的目标，真正要被杀害的敌人，他是一名联邦国防军士兵，却伪装成叙利亚人。

sentences.en: He posed as a Syrian to make refugees responsible.
sentences.zh: 他伪装成叙利亚人，是为了让难民承担责任。

sentences.en: So this was the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的想法。

sentences.en: They would kill people, enemies, but then they would blame refugees to be the perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 他们会杀害人们、敌人，然后把罪名嫁祸给难民，让他们成为凶手。

sentences.en: The case against Franco A.
sentences.zh: 针对弗兰科·A的案件

sentences.en: is remarkable for many reasons.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面都引人注目。

sentences.en: Not only that, as far as anyone I've talked to can remember, he's the first active-duty soldier to stand trial for plotting terrorism since World War II.
sentences.zh: 不仅据我交谈过所有人所能记忆的，他是自二战以来第一个因策划恐怖主义而受审的现役军人。

sentences.en: Or that his arrest opened the door to a countrywide network of people planning for Day X.
sentences.zh: 或者说他的被捕为全国范围内策划X日的人群打开了大门。

sentences.en: Or even that he had lived a double life as a Syrian refugee.
sentences.zh: 甚至是他曾过着叙利亚难民的双重生活。

sentences.en: What's most remarkable is that the German authorities had been utterly blind to him.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是，德国当局对他的存在完全视而不见。

sentences.en: It took a maintenance man stumbling upon a gun in an airport bathroom to uncover it all.
sentences.zh: 直到一名维修工偶然在机场厕所里发现了一把枪，这一切才被揭开。

sentences.en: It was just chance.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是巧合。

sentences.en: Back when I first started reporting on this case, I called one of Franco A.'s lawyers to ask if Franco would talk.
sentences.zh: 当年我开始报道这个案子时，我给弗兰科·A的一个律师打电话，询问弗兰科是否愿意接受采访。

sentences.en: The lawyer was doubtful, but said he'd pass along the message.
sentences.zh: 律师表示怀疑，但说他会把消息转达过去。

sentences.en: I also called the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 我也给检方打了电话。

sentences.en: They wouldn't talk on the record.
sentences.zh: 他们不愿公开表态。

sentences.en: But in their indictment, they're making the case that Franco A.
sentences.zh: 但在他们的起诉书中，他们提出弗兰科·A

sentences.en: has a far-right mindset.
sentences.zh: 有着极右翼的心态。

sentences.en: They quote from voice memos found on Franco's phone, where he questions how Germany atones for the Holocaust,
sentences.zh: 他们引用了在弗兰科手机上找到的语音备忘录，他在其中质疑德国如何为犹太人大屠杀赎罪，

sentences.en: argues that immigration has ruined Germany's ethnic purity, and says things like, I know you will murder me.
sentences.zh: 认为移民毁了德国的种族纯洁性，并说出诸如“我知道你会谋杀我，我会先谋杀你”之类的话。

sentences.en: I will murder you firSt.
sentences.zh: 我会先谋杀你。

sentences.en: They say Franco A.
sentences.zh: 他们说弗兰科·A

sentences.en: was firmly decided to commit a violent act.
sentences.zh: 坚决决定实施暴力行为。

sentences.en: And they point to handwritten notes with the names of prominent politicians and activists.
sentences.zh: 他们还指出了写有知名政客和活动人士名字的手写便条。

sentences.en: And they say that one Friday, in the summer of 2016,
sentences.zh: 他们说，在2016年夏天的一个周五，

sentences.en: Franco A.
sentences.zh: 弗兰科·A

sentences.en: traveled to Berlin, where one of those people worked.
sentences.zh: 前往柏林，其中一个人的工作地点就在那里。

sentences.en: They say he drew a map of the location of the building, and that he went inside the parking garage and took pictures of the license plates of several cars.
sentences.zh: 他们说他画了一张该建筑位置的地图，并进入停车场拍下了几辆车的车牌照片。

sentences.en: And in the days after, according to one witness, He was at a shooting range with an assault rifle.
sentences.zh: 据一位目击者称，在随后的几天里，他带着一把突击步枪去了一个射击场。

sentences.en: Franco A.
sentences.zh: 弗兰科·A

sentences.en: denies all the terrorism charges against him.
sentences.zh: 否认了对他所有的恐怖主义指控。

sentences.en: But his case has come to represent something investigators are increasingly worried about.
sentences.zh: 但他的案件代表了调查人员日益担忧的一种现象。

sentences.en: That Day X is not just an imagined day of future crisis,
sentences.zh: 即X日不仅是未来危机的一个想象中的日子，

sentences.en: but a call for action, a pretext for terrorism, or worse.
sentences.zh: 而是行动的号召、恐怖主义的借口，或者更糟糕的，

sentences.en: a coup.
sentences.zh: 是一场政变。

sentences.en: And that's why, prosecutors say, Franco A picked the targets that he did.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，检察官表示，弗兰科·A才挑选了那些目标。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Katrin Van Holt.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是卡特琳·范霍尔特。

sentences.en: This is Day X.
sentences.zh: 这是《X日》。

sentences.en: I wonder if that's where he got access to the parking garage.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他是不是从那里进入停车场的。

sentences.en: And there's no guard in this building that we can see.
sentences.zh: 而且这座建筑里我们看不到任何警卫。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wonder what security is going to be like.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我不知道安保会是什么样。

sentences.en: Should we ring the bell?
sentences.zh: 我们要按门铃吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: In December 2019, I went with producers Claire Tennesketter and Lindsay Garrison to that office building in Berlin to meet one of Franco A's alleged targets.
sentences.zh: 2019年12月，我和制片人克莱尔·特内斯凯特和林赛·加里森一起去了柏林的那个办公大楼，去见弗兰科·A的疑似目标之一。

sentences.en: Let me maybe start just by asking you if you could just sort of say who you are and what you do.
sentences.zh: 或许我先问你一个问题，能否请你简单介绍一下你是谁以及你做什么。

sentences.en: My name is Annetta Kahane.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿内塔·卡哈内。

sentences.en: I'm the chairperson of the Amadeo Antony Foundation.
sentences.zh: 我是阿玛迪奥·安东尼基金会的主席。

sentences.en: And the Amadeo Antony Foundation is trying to fight racism, anti-Semitism and right-wing extremism.
sentences.zh: 阿玛迪奥·安东尼基金会正致力于打击种族主义、反犹太主义和右翼极端主义。

sentences.en: Annetta is one of the most prominent human rights activists in the country.
sentences.zh: 阿内塔是该国最著名的人权活动人士之一。

sentences.en: And in this sort of position, have you had particular moments of being threatened?
sentences.zh: 在这种职位上，你有没有经历过受到特别威胁的时刻？

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: It's part of our daily life.
sentences.zh: 这是我们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: It's part of my daily life.
sentences.zh: 这是我日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: And it's not so easy to deal with that.
sentences.zh: 应对这些并不是那么容易。

sentences.en: But in the end of the day, I'm used to it somehow.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我已经某种程度上习惯了。

sentences.en: She's also one of the most hated figures on the far right, up there with Chancellor Angela Merkel.
sentences.zh: 她也是极右翼中最遭恨的人物之一，与安格拉·默克尔总理不相上下。

sentences.en: She pulls out a phone and shows us the emails she's been getting.
sentences.zh: 她掏出手机，给我们看她收到的电子邮件。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There's sort of endless, like dozens and dozens of hate mail.
sentences.zh: 有种无穷无尽的感觉，就像几十封又几十封的仇恨邮件。

sentences.en: Horrible things.
sentences.zh: 可怕的事情。

sentences.en: I have a lot of this.
sentences.zh: 我有很多这样的邮件。

sentences.en: This is really striking.
sentences.zh: 这真的很令人震惊。

sentences.en: This arrived this morning on email.
sentences.zh: 这是今天早上通过电子邮件收到的。

sentences.en: It's like, congratulations.
sentences.zh: 就像是，恭喜。

sentences.en: Congratulations, you are now first place on our killing liSt.
sentences.zh: 恭喜，你现在荣登我们杀戮名单的第一名。

sentences.en: We will cut you a swastika into your face with a very sharp axe.
sentences.zh: 我们将用一把非常锋利的斧头在你的脸刻下一个卍字标志。

sentences.en: and afterwards we will cut your rückenmark your spine your spine and we will leave you in to die in some side street yeah we'll kill every
sentences.zh: 然后我们会割断你的脊髓，你的脊髓，我们会让你死在某条小巷里，是的，我们会杀死每一个

sentences.en: non-Aryan every Jewish Muslim and worthless worthless life in our wonderful beautiful Germany and erase you from our history books.
sentences.zh: 非雅利安人、每一个犹太人、穆斯林以及我们伟大美丽的德国中毫无价值、毫无价值的生命，并将你从我们的历史书中抹去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then this.
sentences.zh: 然后是这个。

sentences.en: We will be a lot more efficient than our ancestors in 1938.
sentences.zh: 我们将比1938年的前辈们效率高得多。

sentences.en: I mean, this is...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是……

sentences.en: How does it end?
sentences.zh: 它是怎么结束的？

sentences.en: What's, like, the final line?
sentences.zh: 最后一句是什么？

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Sieg Heil.
sentences.zh: 胜利万岁。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And is this every single day that you get something like this?
sentences.zh: 你每天都会收到这样的东西吗？

sentences.en: Not every day, but sometimes, yes.
sentences.zh: 不是每天，但有时会，是的。

sentences.en: Is it safe to be Jewish in Germany today?
sentences.zh: 今天在德国做犹太人安全吗？

sentences.en: It is not safe, no.
sentences.zh: 不安全，不。

sentences.en: When was the time in Germany that you felt the most comfortable with being Jewish?
sentences.zh: 在德国，你什么时候觉得作为犹太人最自在？

sentences.en: I don't remember.
sentences.zh: 我不记得了。

sentences.en: It was always difficult.
sentences.zh: 一直都很困难。

sentences.en: Tell us a little bit about your childhood.
sentences.zh: 跟我们聊聊你的童年吧。

sentences.en: Where did you grow up?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里长大的？

sentences.en: In Berlin, mainly.
sentences.zh: 主要在柏林。

sentences.en: Which part?
sentences.zh: 哪个区？

sentences.en: East Berlin, in Pankow.
sentences.zh: 东柏林，在潘科。

sentences.en: Annetta grew up in the shadow of the Berlin Wall.
sentences.zh: 阿内塔是在柏林墙的阴影下长大的。

sentences.en: in a Soviet-controlled East Germany that had claimed to have eliminated the Nazi problem.
sentences.zh: 在一个声称已经消除了纳粹问题的苏联控制的东德里。

sentences.en: Her parents were Holocaust survivors.
sentences.zh: 她的父母是大屠杀幸存者。

sentences.en: They were Jewish, and they were communists who fought in the resistance against fascism.
sentences.zh: 他们是犹太人，也是参加反法西斯抵抗运动的共产党员。

sentences.en: And they taught their daughter that communism was the surest way to prevent something like the Nazis from ever happening again.
sentences.zh: 他们教导女儿，共产主义是防止类似纳粹事件再次发生的最佳途径。

sentences.en: They tell her that under communism, everyone was equal.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她，在共产主义下，每个人都是平等的。

sentences.en: So things like racism and anti-Semitism them.
sentences.zh: 所以像种族主义和反犹太主义这样的事情。

sentences.en: They simply couldn't exiSt. But going to school in East Berlin, Annetta started to sense something else.
sentences.zh: 它们根本不可能存在。但在东柏林上学时，阿内塔开始感觉到一些别的东西。

sentences.en: I saw all these parents of my friends, and they were looking at me a little bit, what is she?
sentences.zh: 我看到我朋友的所有这些父母，他们看着我的眼神有点奇怪，她是什么人？

sentences.en: Somehow she's different.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，她与众不同。

sentences.en: And I just knew that I feel strange.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我感觉很奇怪。

sentences.en: I was a strange one.
sentences.zh: 我是个怪人。

sentences.en: But of course, they told me all these terrible jokes about burning Jews and what fun it is to kill Jews and things like that.
sentences.zh: 但当然，他们对我说那些关于焚烧犹太人的可怕笑话，以及杀死犹太人是多么有趣之类的话。

sentences.en: Blaming me also as a Jewish pig and things like that.
sentences.zh: 还指责我是犹太猪之类的话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, it was very present.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常普遍。

sentences.en: For a long time, I didn't know it was anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，我不知道那是反犹太主义。

sentences.en: I just felt like I'm an idiot.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得自己是个白痴。

sentences.en: She'd go to her dad and tell him what she was feeling.
sentences.zh: 她会去找她父亲，告诉他她的感受。

sentences.en: They came home and I said, I don't feel good.
sentences.zh: 他们回到家，我说，我感觉不好。

sentences.en: I was feeling like something very strange and very lonely.
sentences.zh: 我感觉有些事情非常奇怪而且非常孤独。

sentences.en: But he didn't really get it.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有真正理解。

sentences.en: One day he said, I don't know why you always have these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 有一天他说，我不知道为什么你总是有这些问题。

sentences.en: I mean, what is the problem?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，问题是什么？

sentences.en: This is all comrades outside there.
sentences.zh: 外面全都是同志。

sentences.en: They're all members of the party, so they must be nice.
sentences.zh: 他们都是党员，所以他们一定很好。

sentences.en: So this was the impression that I'm not good enough for being a good communiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以给我的印象是我不够资格成为一个好共产党员。

sentences.en: I was not trusting my impressions, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不相信自己的直觉。

sentences.en: It was like a gaslight situation.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种煤气灯操纵的情境。

sentences.en: For years, Annetta convinced herself that what she was experiencing wasn't real.
sentences.zh: 多年来，阿内塔说服自己，她所经历的事情并不是真的。

sentences.en: She says she tried to be a good communiSt.
sentences.zh: 她说她曾努力做一个好共产党员。

sentences.en: When she was 19, the Stasi knocked on her door.
sentences.zh: 在她19岁的时候，国家安全局（斯塔西）敲响了她的门。

sentences.en: And for several years, she was an informant for one of the most repressive police intelligence services in the world.
sentences.zh: 在好几年的时间里，她是世界上最具压迫性的警察情报机构之一的线人。

sentences.en: Of course, it was a terrible thing.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一件糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: And I mean, I'm not proud of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我并不为此感到骄傲。

sentences.en: But by the time she's in her 30s, the problems her parents had dismissed her whole life were now visible on the streets.
sentences.zh: 但到了她30多岁时，她父母一生都在忽视的问题现在在街头显现出来了。

sentences.en: In the middle of the 80s, this neo-Nazi movement started to be very, very strong.
sentences.zh: 在80年代中期，这个新纳粹运动开始变得非常、非常强大。

sentences.en: A potent neo-Nazi movement with thousands of members was growing.
sentences.zh: 一个拥有数千名成员的强大新纳粹运动正在发展壮大。

sentences.en: You could see them?
sentences.zh: 你能看到他们吗？

sentences.en: Did they look like what we, in those early 90s, like basically bold hats?
sentences.zh: 他们看起来像我们在90年代初看到的那样，基本上是光头吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, bold hats and skin hats, all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 是的，光头和皮肤党之类的东西。

sentences.en: And they were really very violent and they beat up a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 他们确实非常暴力，殴打了很多的人。

sentences.en: And yet, the government denied the existence of far-right extremists point blank.
sentences.zh: 然而，政府却断然否认极右翼极端分子的存在。

sentences.en: The official line was, there are no neo-Nazis in communist East Germany.
sentences.zh: 官方的说法是，共产主义的东德没有新纳粹。

sentences.en: This was a very, very bad situation.
sentences.zh: 这曾是一种非常、非常糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, my God, this is a state that calls himself anti-fascist and does nothing about these Nazis.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，天哪，这是一个自称反法西斯的国家，却对这些纳粹分子无所作为。

sentences.en: And I thought, why?
sentences.zh: 然后我想，为什么？

sentences.en: I used to be so naive.
sentences.zh: 我以前太天真了。

sentences.en: Now I see this anti-fascism is not real.
sentences.zh: 现在我发现这种反法西斯主义并不是真的。

sentences.en: The opposite of fascism is not anti-fascism, but a democratic, vibrant culture.

sentences.zh: 达豪是一种许多人被杀害的集中营。

sentences.en: I'm not sure whether we, the children, understood what probably nobody can understand.
sentences.zh: 我不确定我们这些孩子是否理解了那些可能谁也无法理解的事情。

sentences.en: But I think it was my parents that wanted to understand what had happened and what it means to be German.
sentences.zh: 但我认为正是我的父母想要弄明白究竟发生了什么，以及身为德国人意味着什么。

sentences.en: What does it mean?
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么？

sentences.en: And my father said, you are born 10 years after the end of the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说，你出生在第二次世界大战结束十年之后。

sentences.en: After the worst crimes ever.
sentences.zh: 经历过有史以来最严重的罪行之后。

sentences.en: But what happened in the Nazi time, the Nazi terror, the crimes are part of your biography.
sentences.zh: 但纳粹时期发生的事情、纳粹的恐怖统治以及那些罪行，都是你生平的一部分。

sentences.en: Not easy to understand what it means.
sentences.zh: 要理解这意味着什么并不容易。

sentences.en: This German struggle for national identity actually became part of German identity.
sentences.zh: 这场德国人对国家认同的挣扎，实际上已经成了德国认同的一部分。

sentences.en: And for Claudia, there's still this sense of humility.
sentences.zh: 对克劳迪娅来说，这种谦卑感依然存在。

sentences.en: the sense that, as a country, Germany has been on the wrong side of history.
sentences.zh: 那种作为一个国家，德国一直站在历史错误一边的感觉。

sentences.en: Can I love Germany?
sentences.zh: 我能爱德国吗？

sentences.en: I would never say this.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会这么说。

sentences.en: Can I be proud?
sentences.zh: 我能感到骄傲吗？

sentences.en: Being a German?
sentences.zh: 作为一个德国人？

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: I would never say I'm proud.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会说我为此感到骄傲。

sentences.en: German flag?
sentences.zh: 德国国旗？

sentences.en: No, this was never, ever.
sentences.zh: 不，这绝对、绝对不可能。

sentences.en: I'm a German, yes.
sentences.zh: 我是个德国人，是的。

sentences.en: I do not hide.
sentences.zh: 我没有隐瞒。

sentences.en: But proud?
sentences.zh: 但骄傲？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I'm a chairman with all responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 我是一个承担全部责任的公民。

sentences.en: I am, meanwhile, happy and proud that there are so many people who are fighting for a stronger democracy, who try to establish a multicultural democracy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我感到高兴和自豪的是，有这么多人正在为建设一个更强大的民主体制而战，正试图建立一个多元文化的民主体制。

sentences.en: A society of the many.
sentences.zh: 一个属于大众的社会。

sentences.en: A society of the many.
sentences.zh: 一个属于大众的社会。

sentences.en: The idea of a multicultural democracy and how to protect it is enshrined in Germany's post-war constitution.
sentences.zh: 多元文化民主的理念以及如何保护它，已被写入德国战后宪法。

sentences.en: Article 1 in our constitution, the most wonderful sentence ever.
sentences.zh: 我们宪法的第一条，是有史以来最美妙的一句话。

sentences.en: The dignity of human being is untouchable.
sentences.zh: 人的尊严不可侵犯。

sentences.en: It was written with the explicit aim to prevent something like the Nazi era from ever happening again.
sentences.zh: 它的撰写带有明确的目的，即防止纳粹时期的悲剧再次上演。

sentences.en: Not the dignity of a German human being or a white or a Christian, but the dignity of any human being.
sentences.zh: 不是德国人的尊严，也不是白人或基督教徒的尊严，而是任何人的尊严。

sentences.en: Yeah, perhaps this is why I am Claudia with all her fights against racism, against xenophobia, against sexism, against homophobia, against Islamophobia, against anti-Semitism,
sentences.zh: 是的，也许这就是为什么我是克劳迪娅，她一直在与种族主义、仇外心理、性别歧视、恐同心理、仇视伊斯兰教以及反犹太主义作斗争，

sentences.en: against all these things that try to discriminate and separate people.
sentences.zh: 与所有这些试图歧视和割裂人们的事物作斗争。

sentences.en: Claudia was first elected for the Greens in 1989,
sentences.zh: 克劳迪娅于1989年首次当选绿党议员，

sentences.en: the year the Berlin Wall fell.
sentences.zh: 那是柏林墙倒塌的一年。

sentences.en: And who she became and what fuels her politics, this is what defines Germany today.
sentences.zh: 她成为了什么样的人，是什么在驱动她的政治理念，正是这些定义了今天的德国。

sentences.en: It's the Germany that atones for the Holocaust with memorials and history lessons in every public school.
sentences.zh: 正是那个通过纪念碑和每所公立学校的历史课来为犹太人大屠杀赎罪的德国。

sentences.en: The Germany that elected Angela Merkel, that admitted over a million refugees, and that has come to define liberal democracy in Europe and beyond.
sentences.zh: 那个选举了安格拉·默克尔、接纳了超过一百万难民、并在欧洲乃至更广范围重新定义了自由民主的德国。

sentences.en: But it's also the Germany that has given rise to a powerful backlash.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一个引发了强烈反弹的德国。

sentences.en: In 2017, a far-right party was elected into parliament for the first time since the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 2017年，一个极右翼政党自纳粹以来首次进入议会。

sentences.en: This is a party that didn't even exist a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在几年前甚至还不存在的政党。

sentences.en: The AfD.
sentences.zh: 德国选择党（AfD）。

sentences.en: Alternative for Deutschland.
sentences.zh: 德国选择党。

sentences.en: Its power base is in the former communist EaSt.
sentences.zh: 它的权力基础在前共产主义的东部地区。

sentences.en: And it's the polar opposite of Claudia's party.
sentences.zh: 这与克劳迪娅的政党截然相反。

sentences.en: Of course I'm concerned and I'm afraid and I see this radicalization.
sentences.zh: 我当然感到担忧和害怕，我也看到了这种激进化。

sentences.en: The AfD's popularity has surged amid Chancellor Angela Merkel's open-door migration policy.
sentences.zh: 在总理安格拉·默克尔采取门户开放的移民政策期间，德国选择党的人气激增。

sentences.en: They are the loudspeaker for the extremists.
sentences.zh: 他们是极端分子的扩音器。

sentences.en: And outside of Parliament, the far-right has turned increasingly violent.
sentences.zh: 在议会之外，极右翼也变得日益暴力。

sentences.en: Two people killed in a shooting rampage near a synagogue in the eastern German town.
sentences.zh: 在德国东部一个小镇的一座犹太教堂附近发生了一起枪击狂潮，造成两人死亡。

sentences.en: To say they are only Einzel tater, they are only lonely wolves, it's absolutely not true.
sentences.zh: 说什么他们只是“Einzel tater”，他们只是孤狼，这绝对不是真的。

sentences.en: It has happened again.
sentences.zh: 悲剧再次上演了。

sentences.en: Germany is reeling tonight following the deaths of 10 people in another far-right terror attack.
sentences.zh: 在又一次极右翼恐怖袭击导致10人死亡之后，德国今晚正处在震惊之中。

sentences.en: Over the past few years, Germany has suffered a series of deadly far-right terror attacks.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，德国遭遇了一系列致命的极右翼恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: Police in Germany have arrested a suspect in connection with the shooting of a CDU politician.
sentences.zh: 德国警方已经逮捕了一名与枪击基民盟政治人物有关的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Including the assassination of a politician in 2019.
sentences.zh: 其中包括2019年一名政治人物遭暗杀事件。

sentences.en: Walter Lübcke, who was head of the city council in Kassel.
sentences.zh: 卡塞尔市议会负责人沃尔特·吕布克。

sentences.en: Walter Lübcke, a regional official in Angela Merkel's party.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·吕布克，安格拉·默克尔党内的一名地方官员。

sentences.en: who, like Annetta and Claudia, was on numerous far-right death lists.
sentences.zh: 他和安内塔以及克劳迪娅一样，也在无数个极右翼的死亡黑名单上。

sentences.en: Lubke had previously received death threats from right-wing extremists after he voiced his support for Merkel's decision to open Germany's borders to refugees.
sentences.zh: 此前，吕布克曾公开支持默克尔允许难民进入德国边境的决定，因此遭到了右翼极端分子的死亡威胁。

sentences.en: He was shot on his terrace at close range by a well-known neo-Nazi.
sentences.zh: 他在自己的露台上被一名臭名昭著的新纳粹分子近距离枪杀。

sentences.en: Nearly three months after the Lubke murder,
sentences.zh: 在吕布克遇害近三个月后，

sentences.en: prosecutors win their appeal in Germany's Supreme Court to try Franco A on terrorism charges.
sentences.zh: 检方在德国最高法院上诉成功，得以以恐怖主义罪名审判弗兰科·A。

sentences.en: The judges rule that just because Franco A.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定，仅凭弗兰科·A.

sentences.en: had not killed anyone by the time he was arrested, that didn't mean he wasn't going to.
sentences.zh: 在被捕时尚未杀害任何人，并不意味着他不会去杀人。

sentences.en: That it wasn't the timing, but the intention that really mattered.
sentences.zh: 真正重要的不是时机，而是意图。

sentences.en: And so now, Franco A.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，弗兰科·A.

sentences.en: is standing trial.
sentences.zh: 正面临审判。

sentences.en: A single case.
sentences.zh: 这是一起孤立的案件。

sentences.en: But for Claudia, this is about something bigger.
sentences.zh: 但对克劳迪娅来说，这关乎更宏大的问题。

sentences.en: What I do not understand, he committed a lot of different crimes.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解的是，他犯下了许多不同的罪行。

sentences.en: He was very outspoken in his anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 他毫不掩饰自己的反犹太主义。

sentences.en: Nobody understood that he's anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 没有人意识到他是反犹主义者。

sentences.en: And at the same time in the Bundeswehr,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在联邦国防军内部，

sentences.en: he had evidently stolen explosives,
sentences.zh: 他显然偷走了炸药，

sentences.en: whole boxes of ammunition from army, And no military, superior, no intelligence service, no investigation officer noticed this.
sentences.zh: 从军队偷走整箱弹药，而没有一个军事长官、没有一个情报机构、没有一个调查官员注意到这一点。

sentences.en: Difficult and hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 这令人难以置信，也难以接受。

sentences.en: For her, and for many others, it's about a pattern in Germany.
sentences.zh: 对她以及许多其他人来说，这暴露出德国的一种模式。

sentences.en: Of the authorities turning a blind eye to the far right.
sentences.zh: 即官方对极右翼视而不见的模式。

sentences.en: because Franco A.
sentences.zh: 因为弗兰科·A.

sentences.en: is not the first case to be discovered by chance.
sentences.zh: 并不是第一起偶然被发现的案件。

sentences.en: Do you think that the blindness of the police towards the possibility of neo-Nazis being behind this, does this tell us that the police had sympathies in that direction
sentences.zh: 你认为警察对新纳粹可能在其背后推波助澜的视而不见，这是否说明警方对那个方向抱有同情

sentences.en: or is it just that they couldn't imagine it?
sentences.zh: 还是说他们只是无法想象？

sentences.en: This is the point that I want to understand.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想弄明白的关键点。

sentences.en: I would not say that these policemen are all Nazis, but they all make the same mistake.
sentences.zh: 我不会说这些警察全都是纳粹，但他们都犯了同样的错误。

sentences.en: So I want to understand why.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要弄清楚为什么。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.zh: 以下是今天您还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: President Biden has offered Senate Republicans a set of major concessions in negotiations over an infrastructure bill,
sentences.zh: 在基建法案的谈判中，拜登总统向参议院共和党人提出了一系列重大让步，

sentences.en: expressing a willingness to scale back the size of the plan from $2 trillion to $1 trillion, and to remove a proposed increase in the corporate tax rate to pay for the bill.
sentences.zh: 表示愿意将该计划的规模从2万亿美元缩减至1万亿美元，并取消为法案筹资而提议提高的企业税率。

sentences.en: That increase in the corporate tax rate, from 21% to 28%, has been vigorously opposed by the Senate Republicans
sentences.zh: 参议院共和党人一直坚决反对将企业税率从21%提高到28%

sentences.en: because it would reverse tax cuts put in place by former President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为这会推翻前总统特朗普实施的减税政策。

sentences.en: Instead, Biden is now proposing to pay for the infrastructure package through other tax proposals, such as cracking down on offshore corporate tax shelters.
sentences.zh: 作为替代，拜登现在提议通过其他税收提案来为基建一揽子计划筹资，例如打击海外企业避税天堂。

sentences.en: But even with those offers, no Republican support is assured.
sentences.zh: 但即便做出了这些妥协，也不能保证能获得共和党的支持。

sentences.en: and Biden may abandon the negotiations as early as next week to pursue an even larger bill with only Democratic support.
sentences.zh: 拜登甚至最早可能在下周放弃谈判，转而寻求仅凭民主党支持就能通过规模更大的法案。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了数十位自诩为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时甚至惊心动魄的权力斗争中。
